title: Solabia appoints Muriel Koch as President and Chief Executive Officer
summary: Solabia Group, a leading international supplier of ingredients for the cosmetics, nutrition and life sciences markets, announces that Muriel Koch has taken up her position as President and Chief Executive Officer, effective 29 October 2026

title: Solabia announces strategic partnership with Ethical Naturals Inc.
summary: Solabia strengthens its position in nutraceutical ingredients and expands its presence in the U.S. through a strategic partnership and majority investment in Ethical Naturals Inc

title: SCS awards celebrate the people and innovations advancing cosmetic science
summary: The Society for Cosmetic Science (SCS) announced the winners of its 2026 awards at the SCS Annual Dinner and Awards Evening on Tuesday 10th November 2026, recognising exceptional contributions to cosmetic science education, ingredient research and product formulation

title: Sephora to Tropic Skincare: Inside beauty’s 2026 Christmas advert battle
summary: From Sephora US’ Seth Rogen takeover and Ulta Beauty teaming up with famous beauty brand founders Tate McRae and Selena Gomez, to Tropic Skincare’s beauty bakery advert and e.l.f. Brands’ stop motion animation, the 2026 festive beauty campaign battle is heating up

title: Vaseline unveils first facial skin care range to target sun-induced melasma
summary: The Unilever-owned brand is breaking into the therapeutic facial skin care category with Pro Derma Melasma Repair, a range backed by 12 years of research and formulated with Glycoxome technology to target sun-induced melasma at the point of formation

title: Collagen in skin care: can topical creams really work?
summary: In Cosmetics Business’ latest ‘Bench to Bottle’ instalment, Rinki Pramanik explores the science behind cosmetic collagen, how far its benefits can reach the finished bottle, and how K-beauty has transformed collagen formulas

title: The detoxifying ally for menopausal skin
summary: Menopause is a key step in a woman’s life, marked by significant biological transformations. As a result of the cessation of menstruations, it has been shown that menopause causes increased levels of iron in the skin and an accumulation of ferritin, an iron storage protein

title: E45 owner Karo Healthcare appoints new CEO to ‘scale the business’
summary: Karo Healthcare has named Sue Egstrand CEO, joining the company to lead its ‘next phase of growth’ as it makes a bid to become a top five consumer health care player in Europe

title: Estée Lauder Companies and Duty Free Americas unveil beauty destination at Miami International Airport
summary: As part of ‘a renewed global retail partnership’ in North America, the Estée Lauder Companies and Duty Free Americas have opened a new store at Miami International Airport to tap into travellers growing appetite for ‘elevated’ travel retail experiences
